name: Breadcrumbs
description: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy, with links back up.

props.name: items
props.type: { label: string; href?: string; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: From the root to the current page, which is last.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark. Default "Breadcrumb".

a11y: A <nav> with an ordered list; the last item has aria-current="page".
Separators are aria-hidden so they are not read between items.
